title: Kenya — Rift Valley, Lakes & the Mara
sub: Seven days door to door — fly in from Cape Town, five days from a capital with its own national park to the great herds of the Mara, and fly home. Tap a day to fly or drive it.
cap: Illustrative 7-day fly-in safari · real Kenyan parks, airports & towns shown for bearing; lodges & food generic (SO-1b). Flight fares are indicative cached data (Aviasales, 10 Aug 2026) — flights and safari are booked by your travel agency, never through MarketSquare; the introduction is the product. A demo a real tour operator could publish as their own — free to claim. AI imagery.

days.title: Fly in from the Cape
days.summary: Five hours up the spine of Africa — indicative return from ~R8,900 (cached fare, 10 Aug 2026); your travel agency confirms, books and tickets it. Check live fares ↗ (indicative — your agency confirms & books)

stops.name: Cape Town International · departure
stops.blurb: Table Mountain out the left window as you climb, the Cape Flats falling away — next stop, the equator.

stops.name: The Rift from seat 23A
stops.blurb: The Great Rift's lakes glinting silver below, thunderheads stacked over the escarpments — Africa end to end from ten kilometres up.

stops.name: Jomo Kenyatta International · arrival
stops.blurb: Karibu Kenya — a stamp, warm equatorial evening air, and a driver holding a board with your lodge's name.

stops.name: Arrival night · Karen cottage
stops.blurb: Lamplight, a pot of chai and the smell of rain on red earth — asleep before the jet lag notices.

days.title: The city with a national park
days.summary: Lion and rhino against a skyline of cranes and towers — then coffee country in Karen by dark.

stops.name: Nairobi · departure
stops.blurb: Matatus in full graffiti colour, hawkers with the morning papers, and the park gate twenty minutes from the towers.

stops.name: Nairobi National Park · dawn drive
stops.blurb: The only national park on earth inside a capital — black rhino grazing while the city hums on the horizon.

stops.name: Karen Blixen Museum
stops.blurb: The farmhouse at the foot of the Ngong Hills where 'Out of Africa' began — lawns, verandahs and old coffee ghosts.

stops.name: Nyama choma lunch
stops.blurb: Goat and beef straight off the grill, cut at the table with kachumbari and ugali — Kenya's great shared meal.

stops.name: Coffee-garden cottage · Karen
stops.blurb: A stone cottage under old trees in coffee country, log fire lit at seven, colobus monkeys in the canopy at dawn.

days.title: Down the Great Rift
days.summary: Off the escarpment edge into the valley that made humankind — ending on a lake loud with hippos.

stops.name: Out of the highlands
stops.blurb: Up through eucalyptus and tea-green shambas to the lip of the escarpment.

stops.name: Great Rift Valley viewpoint
stops.blurb: The floor drops six hundred metres and the valley runs unbroken to the horizon, volcano cones floating in the haze.

stops.name: Lake Naivasha by boat
stops.blurb: Fish eagles calling from dead acacias, pelicans in formation, and hippo eyes everywhere in the papyrus shallows.

stops.name: Lakeside tilapia lunch
stops.blurb: Whole tilapia fried crisp, lemon and chilli, eaten at a plank table with the lake glittering behind.

stops.name: Lakeshore tented camp
stops.blurb: Canvas under yellow-barked acacias; after dark the hippos come ashore to mow the lawn around the tents.

days.title: Hell's Gate & the flamingo lake
days.summary: Cycling between basalt cliffs in the morning, a lake edged in pink by afternoon.

stops.name: Hell's Gate · cycling the gorge
stops.blurb: Ride a dirt road between red basalt walls, zebra and warthog trotting alongside — the gorge that inspired a lion king.

stops.name: Geothermal vents & towers
stops.blurb: Steam hissing from the rock, a lone volcanic plug rising from the valley floor like a chimney.

stops.name: Chai & mandazi · Nakuru
stops.blurb: Sweet milky chai and warm mandazi doughnuts at a formica table — the mid-journey ritual of every Kenyan road.

stops.name: Lake Nakuru · flamingos & rhino
stops.blurb: A soda lake ringed pink at the shallows, white rhino grazing the shoreline meadows below a fever-tree forest.

stops.name: Ridge lodge above the lake
stops.blurb: Rooms along a cliff line with the whole lake below — baboons on the lawn at six, eagles at eye level all day.

days.title: West to the Mara
days.summary: Wheat country, then acacia scrub, then the first flat-topped trees of the great grassland.

stops.name: South through the wheatlands
stops.blurb: Big-sky farming country rolling toward Narok, combines raising dust on the horizon.

stops.name: Narok market stop
stops.blurb: Pyramids of avocados and red onions, shuka cloth snapping in the wind, the last town before the grass takes over.

stops.name: Maasai homestead visit
stops.blurb: Red shukas against green grass, beadwork with a meaning for every colour, and a jumping dance you will be invited to lose.

stops.name: First game drive · Mara plains
stops.blurb: Elephant families in the croton thickets, giraffe on the skyline, and grass to the curve of the earth.

stops.name: Tented camp by the river
stops.blurb: Lantern-lit canvas above a bend in the river; hippos grumbling below and a lion somewhere north, twice, before sleep.

days.title: The great herds
days.summary: A balloon at dawn, a million wildebeest, and a sundowner to end the journey.

stops.name: Dawn balloon over the Mara
stops.blurb: Lift off in the dark, sunrise from a basket, shadows of hot-air balloons drifting over waking herds.

stops.name: Big cats on the hunt
stops.blurb: A cheetah using a termite mound as a watchtower; lion cubs in the grass pretending not to be seen.

stops.name: Mara River crossing
stops.blurb: Wildebeest massing at the bank, dust and spray and crocodiles — the migration's great gamble, August to October.

stops.name: Bush breakfast on the plains
stops.blurb: Eggs and sausages off a tailgate grill, Kenyan AA coffee from an enamel pot, zebra grazing a respectful distance away.

stops.name: Journey's end · escarpment sundowner
stops.blurb: A camp chair on the Oloololo edge, the whole Mara going gold below — asante sana, and one more night of lion song.

days.title: Fly home
days.summary: A grass strip, a twelve-seater to Nairobi, and the evening flight south — home with red dust still on your boots. Check live fares ↗ (indicative — your agency confirms & books)

stops.name: Bush airstrip · the Mara
stops.blurb: A grass strip mown out of the savannah, a twelve-seater bouncing in, and one last low turn over the herds on climb-out.

stops.name: Nairobi connection
stops.blurb: Across town to Jomo Kenyatta, one last plate of nyama choma in the terminal, and the board flips to CAPE TOWN.

stops.name: Cape Town · home
stops.blurb: Table Mountain rising out the window on approach — asante sana, Kenya; the photos will take weeks to sort.
